chapter.verse: Nong gelh uh thute tawh kisai-in: “Pasal in numei a lawn loh ding hoih hi.”
Himah taleh nulepa tatkhialhna thute' huhau-in pasal in zi a neih ding, numei in zong pasal a neih ding hoih hi.
Pasal in a zi' tungah nupa omkhopna vaipuak cingsak ding a, zi in zong a pasal tungah tua bangin cingsak ding hi.
A hang pen zi in ama' pumpi' tungah ukna thu nei lo a, pasal in uk hi. Tua mah bangin pasal in ama' pumpi' tungah ukna nei lo a, zi in uk hi.

Thungetna neih theih nadinga na kithukim uh hun a kiciangtan khat sung cih simloh, khat in khat dekbawl kei unla, hun a cin ciangin zong pumpi ki-uklahna huhau-in Satan' siatzol tuahkhak loh nadingin a ngei bangin omkik un.
Hih kong gen pen thupiak hilo-in theisiama phalna cih ciang ahi hi.
Note na vekun kei bang na hih ding uh ka lunggulh hi. Ahi zongin mi kim in Pasian' kiangpan hehpihna gah a tuam tek a nei uh hi a, khatlekhat a nam kibang lo hi.
Zi neilote leh meigong numeite keimah bangin tanggawl ahihsuak ding hoih ka sa hi.
Ahi zongin pumpi ki-ukzawhna a neih kei ding uhleh innkuan nei uh hen. A hang pen nulepa lungsim in hong zawh gawp sangin innkuan neih hoihzaw hi.
Innkuan neite' tungah thupiak kong nei ding a, (kei' gen hilo, Topa' genna ah) zi in a pasal ciahsan lo ding hi.
(A ciahsan leh innkuan lo tawh omsuak ding a, ahihkeileh lah a pasal tawh kilemtuahkik ding hi). Pasal in zong a zi ma lo ding hi.
A dang teng' tungah kong genin ah (kei hilo, Topa' gen ah) sanggam khatpeuh a zi thu-umlo mi ahih hangin tua a zi pen amah tawh tensuak ding a ut nakleh pasal in a zi ma lo ding hi.
Numei khatpeuh a pasal thu-umlo mi ahih hangin tua a pasal pen amah tawh tensuak ding a ut nakleh numei in a pasal ciahsan lo ding hi.

Banghanghiam cihleh thu-umlo pasal pen thu-um a zi' hangin a siangtho suak a, thu-umlo zi zong thu-um a pasal' hangin a siangtho suak hi. Tua hikeileh na tate uh a sianglo suak ding a, tu-in ahihleh amaute a siangtho ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin thu-umlo innkuanpih pen in a nusiat leh ahi bang hita hen. Tua bang thute ah thu-um sanggamnu sanggampa a awk nading thu om lo hi. Pasian in note nopna lemna ah hong sam hizaw hi.
A hang pen, zi aw, na pasal a honkhia ding na hih na hihloh bangci theih na hi hiam? Ahihkeileh zong, pasal aw, na zi a honkhia ding na hih na hihloh bangci theih na hi hiam?
Topa' hong sehna bang bekin leh Pasian' hong sapkhiatna bang bekin mi kim nungta tek ta hen. Hih pen pawlpi khempeuh ah ka thupiak ahi hi.
Sapkhiatna a ngah hunin vun-atsa mi khatpeuh a om hiam? Vun-atna lim hepkhiat sawm kei hen. Sapkhiatna a ngah hunin vun-atloh mi a om hiam? Vun-atna san sawm kei hen.
Vun-atna leh vun-atlohna bangmah hilo a, a thupi pen Pasian' thupiaknate zuihna ahi hi.
Mi khat ciat, sapkhiatna a ngah lai-a a omna mun, ama' dinmun mah ah omsuak ta hen.
Sapkhiatna na ngah hunin sila khat na hi hiam? Tua vai nopmawh sa kei in. (Ahih hangin a suakta thei ding na hihleh tua hamphatna la in).
A hang pen sila ahih laitak Topa' sungah sapkhiatna a ngah khat pen Topa' khahkhiat tualmi khat suak hi. Tua mah bangin tualmi suakta ahih laitak sapkhiatna a ngah khat pen Khris' sila a suak ahi hi.
Note, man pia-a hong kileite na hi uh hi; mihing' sila na suak kei un.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, mi khat ciat sapkhiatna a ngah laitakin ama' dinmun bangci bang ahi zongin Pasian tawh kip paisuak ta hen.
Tu-in innkuan a nei ngei nailote tawh kisai-in Topa' kiangpan thupiak ka ngah om lo a, ahi zongin Topa' thukhualna hangin mi muantaak khat ka hihna tawh kei' ngaihsutna kong pia hi.
Tu laitaka lunggimhuai thu tawh en lehang tu tadih na omngei bangun na omsuak ding uh hoih ka sa hi.
Innkuanpih zi a nei khin na hi hiam? Kikhen sawm kei in. Innkuanpih zi nei nailo na hi hiam? Zi zon sawm kei in.

Ahih hangin zi na neih leh khialhna om lo a, nungak in pasal a neih leh zong khialhna om lo hi. Ahi zongin innkuan neite in leitung nuntak gimna thuak ding uh ahih manin tua tawh kong kipelhsak nuam hi.
Sanggamte aw, ka gennop pen a kiseh hun hong tom ta, cih thu hi. Tu-a kipanin zi neite a nei lo bangin om uh henla,
a dah a kapte a dah lo a kap lo bangin, a lungdamte a lungdam lo bangin, vanlena a leite bangmah a nei lo bangin,
leitung a zeekkhate, dimtak a zeekkha lo bangin om uh hen. Banghanghiam cihleh tu-a hih leitung omzia lim pen beilam a manawh ahi hi.
Note, lunghihmawhna tawh na kipelh ding uh kong deih hi. Innkuan a neilo mi in Topa tawh kisai thu, Topa lungkim nading thu lunghimawh hi.
Ahi zongin innkuan nei mi ahihleh leitung thu, a zi' lungkim nading thu lunghimawh a,

a lungsim kikhenkak hi. Tua mah bangin nungak ahihkeileh innkuan neilo numei in Topa tawh kisai thu, kha leh pumpi siantho nading thu lunghimawh hi. Ahih hangin innkuan nei nupi ahihleh leitung thu, a pasal lungkim nading thu lunghimawh hi.
Hih thu, note' phattuam nadinga kong gen hi a, note kong gakcip nading hilo-in tatzia hekzia kilawm na neih nading uh leh Topa' tungah lungsim bup na piak theih nading uh ahi hi.

Mi khatpeuh in ama' nungaknu'c tungah a kilawm bangin gamta lo a kisak leh, nungaknu zong a khangno hun teng kheng khinta ahihleh, zong a tuaci hih kul ahih manin hoih a sak bangin vaihawm t hen; khialhna om lo hi. Kiteng uh hen.
Ahi zongin kuamah ii sawlzawh thu tawh ahilo, amahmah a lungsim kikem zo-in nungaknu tua bangin kemsuak ding ci-in kiptak a khensat zo khempeuh a hoihin a gamta ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin ama' nungaknu a tenpih mi a hoihin a gamta hi a, kuamah tawh a kiteng lo mi hoihzaw kan lai hi.
Zi pen a pasal a nuntak laiteng a pasal tawh a kikhihkhawm ahi hi. Ahih hangin a pasal a sih leh a suakta hita a, ama' deih khatpeuh tawh (Topa' sung bek ah) kiteng thei ta hi.
Ahi zongin kei' hoihsak thu ah a tuaci bangin omsuak hileh nuamsazaw ding hi. Kei zong Pasian' Kha a nei mahin ka kingaihsun hi.
